name: taha/nativephp-android-alarms
description: Create real alarms in the device's system Clock app via AlarmClock.ACTION_SET_ALARM. No AlarmManager, no receivers, no boot logic - the OS Clock app owns and fires the alarms.

bridge_functions.name: Alarm.IsClockAppAvailable
bridge_functions.description: Whether any app can handle ACTION_SET_ALARM (is a Clock app installed)

bridge_functions.name: Alarm.SetWeeklySchedule
bridge_functions.description: Create the weekly alarms, grouped by time via EXTRA_DAYS (fewest intents)

bridge_functions.name: Alarm.OpenAlarmsList
bridge_functions.description: Open the Clock app's alarms list (ACTION_SHOW_ALARMS) so the user can review/remove alarms
